claims.text: LDA and Gibbs sampling were applied to evaluate ISWC and WWW conference publications from 2013-2017, focusing on discovering relationships between topics and paper features.
The evaluation involved extracting abstracts and titles from ISWC and WWW publications using data from the DBLP website, specifically for the years 2013-2017.
MALLET was used to implement inference and obtain topic models for the evaluation of the publications.
